title: ICTS Postdoctoral program 2027 (Fall Cycle)
field: Theoretical sciences (physics, mathematics, biology and related areas)
about: ICTS-TIFR in Bengaluru invites applications for postdoctoral positions in its 2027 fall cycle, with a nominal (negotiable) start on 1 September 2027. Applications close 30 November 2026, 5:00 PM IST; referee letters are due 15 December 2026.
requirements: PhD required by the time of joining
Referee letters due 15 December 2026, 5:00 PM IST
card_alt: EduCut Connect card for the ICTS Postdoctoral program 2027 (Fall Cycle) at the International Centre for Theoretical Sciences (ICTS-TIFR) in Bengaluru, India, deadline 30 Nov 2026. The photo shows the Taj Mahal in Agra, not Bengaluru.
